import os
from nx_mcp.host import heartbeat
root = services.workspace.root
beat = heartbeat.read(root)
call = heartbeat.running_call(root, os.getpid())
print('tool=%s pid_ok=%s session_ok=%s seconds_ok=%s work=%s' % (call['tool'], beat['pid'] == os.getpid(), beat.get('session_id') == services.session_id, 0 <= call['seconds'] <= 10, heartbeat._part_name(beat)))
result = call['seconds']
